body:
It seems that update docs is causing the script to be loaded into the cache, and the cache instance still exists when the resource path is updated.

It can be fixed by #113035. The update of the docs is postponed in that implementation. 

#106299 also appears to be achieved by delaying `update_files()`. I am not familiar with C# modules. However, judging from the error message in #115460, **scan** may have started first. This could be due to subsequent calls, or issues similar to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113628#issuecomment-3619687702 causing `NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_IN`. In other words, simply delaying `update_files()` to **the end of the frame** carries thread risks.
